description: Put several issues into one sprint at once — what «Sprint ▾» does on the cards selected on the board — or, with sprint '' (an empty string) or 'backlog', take them out of their sprints into the backlog. Each issue is answered on its own in 'results': 'moved', 'already' (it was there; nothing written) or 'refused' with 'reason' (not_found, forbidden, paused, scope) and 'error'; the ones that may move do, whatever the others answer. An issue of another project goes into the sprint only where the sprint's project accepts that project and you may write in both. Every issue that moves gets a line in its history under your name; two or more moved are one set of changes, 'changeId', which rollback_sprint_change undoes in one call. Needs full write access in each issue's project and in the sprint's (member, admin or lead).

keys.description: The issues, by key: ['PM-12', 'PM-14']. At most 200.

projectKey.description: The project whose sprints a NAME is looked up among — its own board's and those that accept it. Left out: the first issue's project. An id needs none.

sprint.description: The sprint, by name or id from list_sprints; '' or 'backlog' for the backlog.
